content: Almost two years ago, I gave a talk at the Santa Fe Institute on the importance of mathematics and symbolic reasoning in the age of AI, with the title "Is mathematics obsolete?". I have continued to think about these issues since then, and I just posted an essay with the same title on my web page. (I uploaded it to arXiv more than a week ago, but it is being held for review. I am guessing that the title and format triggered a crackpot alert, which would be understandable.)
